claims.claim: A Government Gateway account is needed to apply for Marriage Allowance.
claims.quote: You’ll need to sign in to use this service. If you do not already have sign in details, you’ll be able to create them.
claims.note: The text says you need to sign in to apply online but does not name Government Gateway as the sign-in.

claims.claim: The lower earner is the one who applies.
claims.quote: If both of you have no income other than your wages, then the person who earns the least should make the claim.
claims.note: The text says the person who earns the least should make the claim.
